mapDescription: Subset of enterprise capabilities demonstrating all visual states: L1 chevrons, L2 boxes, L3 bullets, cross-cutting band, strategic support marker.

capabilities.name: Customer Management
capabilities.definition: Acquire, serve, and retain customers across all channels and lifecycle stages.
capabilities.strategySupport: Drives revenue growth and customer lifetime value.
capabilities.architecturalNuance: Typically anchored on a CRM platform with integrations to marketing automation, service, and commerce.

children.name: Marketing
children.definition: Generate awareness and demand for products and services.

children.name: Campaign Management
children.definition: Plan, execute, and measure multi-channel marketing campaigns.

children.name: Brand Management
children.definition: Steward brand identity, messaging, and assets.

children.name: Customer Segmentation
children.definition: Group customers by behaviour, value, and need to target offers.

children.name: Sales
children.definition: Convert leads into closed-won opportunities.

children.name: Lead Management
children.definition: Capture, qualify, and route leads to sales.

children.name: Opportunity Management
children.definition: Progress qualified deals through the sales pipeline to close.

capabilities.name: Finance
capabilities.definition: Manage capital, revenue, costs, and reporting obligations.

children.name: Accounting
children.definition: Record and report financial transactions.

children.name: General Ledger
children.definition: Maintain the chart of accounts and post journals.

children.name: Accounts Payable
children.definition: Process and pay supplier invoices.

children.name: Financial Planning
children.definition: Plan, budget, and forecast financial performance.

children.name: Budgeting
children.definition: Set annual and multi-year operating and capital budgets.

children.name: Forecasting
children.definition: Project revenue, cost, and cash on a rolling basis.

capabilities.name: Corporate Services
capabilities.definition: Strategy, governance, legal, and enterprise-wide enabling functions.

children.name: Strategy & Planning
children.definition: Set enterprise direction and measure execution.

children.name: Enterprise Strategy
children.definition: Define mission, vision, and multi-year strategic plan.

children.name: Portfolio Management
children.definition: Prioritise and govern the portfolio of programs and projects.

children.name: Governance, Risk & Compliance
children.definition: Manage enterprise risk and meet regulatory obligations.

children.name: Risk Management
children.definition: Identify, assess, and mitigate enterprise risks.

children.name: Compliance
children.definition: Ensure adherence to laws, regulations, and policies.

capabilities.name: Technology
capabilities.definition: Provide the digital platforms, data, and security that power the business.

children.name: Application Management
children.definition: Deliver and operate business applications.

children.name: Software Delivery
children.definition: Build, integrate, and deploy software changes.

children.name: Application Support
children.definition: Operate, monitor, and resolve incidents in production apps.

children.name: Cybersecurity
children.definition: Protect information, identities, and systems.

children.name: Identity & Access Management
children.definition: Authenticate users and authorise access to resources.

children.name: Security Operations
children.definition: Detect and respond to cyber threats.
